rules.title: General prohibition of local rent control; exception
rules.requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A city or town that accepts the chapter may adopt rent control only if it becomes voluntary for owners after six months, does not regulate occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal of properties, does not apply to units of owners with less than ten rental units or units with fair market rent over $400, and compensates owners from general funds.
rules.coverage_text: All cities and towns in Massachusetts; limits any local rent control regulation.
rules.exemptions: A city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that: becomes entirely voluntary for owners after six months from initial adoption; does not regulate occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal of properties; does not apply to any rental unit owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or having a fair market rent exceeding $400; and compensates owners of rent controlled units from the municipality's general funds for the difference between fair market rent and the rent controlled rent.
rules.citation: General Law - Part I, Title VII, Chapter 40P, Section 4
